mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and renal dysfunction that may alter letrozole metabolism and efficacy; letrozole may increase foscarnet nephrotoxicity risk through additive renal stress.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, phosphate), and letrozole efficacy regularly; ensure adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy; consider dose adjustments if renal impairment develops.
